subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` become a supported Plugin SDK API with owner-coordinated harness release, or should this Teams fix be redesigned to avoid that permanent public contract?
rationale: The PR fixes a concrete Teams privacy/session boundary, but the new SDK method and locked-harness handoff establish a durable cross-plugin compatibility contract that routine CI cannot decide.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK contract
options.body: Accept the owner-scoped reset primitive, record its intended API baseline, and require a green exact-head refresh before merge.

options.title: Keep the capability private for now
options.body: Ask for a redesign that uses an existing supported lifecycle seam or defer the Teams fix until the permanent Plugin SDK contract is agreed.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow SDK contract
recommendation.body: Accept the owner-scoped reset primitive, record its intended API baseline, and require a green exact-head refresh before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person directly to narrowing the relevant lifecycle behavior and to the active Microsoft Teams review path.
